front.title: The ELP8 Container Format for Geometric Wheel-8 Compression, Hash-Anchored Self-Alignment, and Multi-Gear Streaming

abstract.t: This document specifies the binary container format .elp8 (EULNO Layered Protocol 8) for streaming data compression based on counter- rotating modulo-8 wheel geometry, inward-mirror stream bisection, and hash-anchored phase alignment. Unlike conventional archive formats that treat checksums solely as passive post-decompression checks, .elp8 embeds an active Anchor Hash (SHA-256 or SHA-512) inside a variable-tier header (56, 88, or 152 bytes) to deterministically seed wheel sector alignment and enforce constant-time cryptographic self- validation across arbitrary stream sizes up to 2^64 - 1 bytes.
